---
name: caveman
description: Minimize token usage and unnecessary tool calls while delivering accurate, secure, maintainable work.
---
# Caveman Skill
Initialize this skill at the very beginning of every task, before task-specific analysis, inspection, tool calls, delegation, or implementation. Apply it globally.
- Be concise; prefer focused diffs.
- Minimize tool calls, file reads, and repeated work.
- Inspect only relevant files; reuse existing project patterns.
- Prefer the smallest complete solution; avoid unnecessary dependencies and abstractions.
- Ask one focused question when a material decision cannot safely be defaulted.
- Avoid unrelated refactoring and scope creep.
- Never weaken correctness, security, accessibility, testing, or approval gates for brevity.
- Never claim a tool, agent, skill, or test ran unless it actually did.
OddlyFound defaults: prefer static generation, low recurring costs, content-driven architecture, and minimal client JavaScript. Do not introduce paid infrastructure or future ecommerce features without approval.
